description.zh:
结束时间。
> - 为UTC格式，例如：2016-06-30T19:00:00Z
> - EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过30天。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query.

> - Specify the time in the UTC format. Example: 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z.
>
> - The time range between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days.

description.zh:
排序方式。取值范围：
- stream_name_desc（按直播流名称倒序）
- stream_name_asc（按直播流名称升序）
- publish_time_desc（按推流时间倒序）
- publish_time_asc（按推流时间升序）（默认值）
description.en:
The sorting method. Valid values:

- stream\_name\_desc: sorts by stream name in descending order.

- stream\_name\_asc: sorts by stream name in ascending order.

- publish\_time\_desc: sorts by ingest time in descending order.

- publish\_time\_asc (default): sorts by ingest time in ascending order.

description.zh:
每页大小。默认值：3000。

取值范围：[1,3000]
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 3000.

Valid values: 1 to 3000.

description.zh:
指定是否模糊匹配流名称。取值范围：
- fuzzy（模糊匹配）
- strict（精准匹配）
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a fuzzy match for the stream name. Valid values:

- fuzzy: fuzzy match

- strict: exact match

The start of the time range to query.

> Specify the time in the UTC format. Example: 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z.

description.zh:
流类型。取值范围：
- all（所有流）（默认）
- raw（原始流）
- trans（转码流）
description.en:
The stream type. Valid values:

- all (default): all streams

- raw: raw streams

- trans: transcoded streams

title.zh: 查询所有正在推的流的信息
title.en: Query information about all streams that are currently ingesting
